mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_log (usr_id, request_type, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens) VALUES (#{usrId}, #{requestType}, #{modelName}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(captured_at, '%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as request_count, SUM(total_tokens) as total_tokens, SUM(prompt_tokens) as prompt_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) as completion_tokens FROM ai_usage_log WHERE captured_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(captured_at, '%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT request_type as name, SUM(total_tokens) as value FROM ai_usage_log GROUP BY request_type
